title: A Weekend in Big Sky
description: A guest guide to a birthday ski weekend in Big Sky, Montana, February 18–22, 2027.
welcome: A few days in the mountains, good company, and a birthday worth gathering for. Here’s your guide to the weekend.
heroAlt: A light-filled mountain living room with a tall stone fireplace, sculptural chandelier, and colorful seating.
heroCaption: Room to gather. Time to unwind.
